data.title: Rapid Wallet Fan-Out Exceeding 100 Wallets Post-Theft
data.description: Detects when a single wallet or cluster distributes funds across 100+ new wallets within 48 hours following a large-value transfer (>$1M). Directly models the DPRK Bybit laundering pattern where PRESSURE CHOLLIMA distributed stolen funds across 125,000+ Ethereum wallets. Existing DL-0196 and DL-0197 cover CEX off-ramp detection; this rule covers the upstream distancing and layering phase.
references: CrowdStrike 2026 Global Threat Report (PRESSURE CHOLLIMA Bybit case)
FATF Targeted Report on Stablecoins and Unhosted Wallets (March 2026)
falsepositives: Exchange hot wallet distributions to customer withdrawal addresses
Airdrop campaigns distributing tokens to large recipient lists
Payroll distributions from corporate treasury wallets
